messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick sync: Orchid is ready to renew but procurement wants to move to NET60 and pay 60/40 split (PO/CC). They also asked for a short services appendix and our vendor code. Can we accommodate without changing price?
Marco (AE): They're asking to keep sticker pricing. Ask FP&A if NET60 + 40% CC upfront is acceptable. Also we should consider a 10% term discount for 24mo vs 12mo if they want longer term.
Ravi (Orchid): Procurement insists NET60 on the PO side. They can do 40% CC at signature. No extra discount requested, prefer pricing unchanged. Will provide vendor PO template.
Sam (Billing): NET60 requires Finance review. Requirements: vendor code, remit address, tax ID, and PO number format. If split is PO/CC we need the CC capture webhook to record authorization.
Procurement Bot: Reminder: "NET60 approvals require Finance + Credit Ops review. Split-pay increases exposure; CC auth recommended at time of signature."
Aisha (CSM): @FP&A can you confirm exposure limits and if 60/40 split is ok for this ARR band? Also tagging Legal Ops for appendix language.
FP&A: ARR is $95k. For under $100k we usually require NET45 or 50% upfront for NET60. 40% upfront is borderline; will need a short credit memo and revenue recognition plan.
Legal Ops: We can produce a one-page services appendix (deliverables + acceptance). Signature options: (1) DocuSign on amendment + appendix, (2) customer PO referencing master + countersign PDF. If PO = NET60, we need an approval note from Finance on thread before invoicing.
Ravi (Orchid): They prefer PO for internal audit. We'll try to get PO to reference "Amendment v1". Will send draft by tomorrow.
Aisha (CSM): Notes for Onboarding Eng: start enablement prep but only greenlight full kickoff after CC payment posts. We'll accept early onboarding tasks queued against expected start date.
Onboarding Eng: Understood. We'll prepare kickoff checklist and training calendar. If PO clears first, we'll still wait for CC capture to mark start date.
Sam (Billing): Proposed flow: (1) capture 40% CC now -> (2) issue invoice for 60% with PO# and NET60 -> (3) monitor collection. Please confirm vendor code for invoice header. Example header: `VendorCode: RWINF-88
TaxID: 98-7654321
PO: ORCH-2026-009`
Marco (AE): I'll push for 50/50 split to meet Finance preferences and offer to adjust term to 15mo pro-rata if they agree.
FP&A: 50% upfront would get automatic NET60 approval. If they insist on 40/60 we'll need exec sign-off.
Ravi (Orchid): I can try to nudge procurement to 50/50. If needed we'll escalate to finance contact.
Aisha (CSM): Action list: Marco to propose 50/50 and 15mo proration; Ravi to share PO draft & vendor code; Legal Ops to attach 1-pg appendix; Sam to prepare invoice template & CC capture link; FP&A to confirm final approval path.
Marco (AE): Reached out to procurement, copying FP&A.
Legal Ops: Drafted appendix and uploaded to shared drive, link in DM to Marco. Will post when finalized.
Sam (Billing): Invoice template + payment link ready. Will send on request.
Aisha (CSM): I'll keep monitoring. Please react with :eyes: once tasks done. We'll close once PO or CC receipt in thread. Thanks team!
